sectors.name: Technology
themes: Indonesia's digital economy is structurally driven by rising internet penetration and a young, mobile-first population, boosting demand for e-commerce and fintech platforms.
Government push for digital infrastructure, including the Palapa Ring project and data center investments, creates durable tailwinds for cloud and connectivity providers.
Local tech players benefit from regulatory protectionism and a growing preference for domestic platforms, insulating them from global tech volatility.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's tech sector underperformed today, dragged by global tech weakness, but select local names like MCAS (+34.59%) and KREN (+7.69%) surged on domestic catalysts. Watch for rotation into digital infrastructure plays as government accelerates digitalization; avoid broad exposure until US rate signals stabilize.

sectors.name: Property & Real Estate

Government's continued push for the new capital Nusantara (IKN) creates a long-term demand corridor for property in Kalimantan, benefiting diversified developers with early exposure.
sectors.ai: Indonesia property sector underperformed sharply (-2.44%) vs US REITs (-0.27%), signaling near-term caution. Focus on BAPI (+6.67%) and MPRO (+6.49%) as liquidity-driven outliers; avoid chasing. Use weakness in DUTI and ARE as entry points for long-term landbank plays, given Jakarta's supply constraints and rate-cut tailwinds expected in H2 2025.
